description:
- Applied version spoof to 17.33.42 by default. This is done because all versions below 17.33.xx no longer work.
- Switched to GmsCore to fix the playback issues. From now on you will need to have [GmsCore](https://github.com/Revanced/GmsCore/releases/latest) installed.
- Reverted the support for dislikes on the old layout as it's no longer accessible.

## :warning: Known Issues
- Videos on the feed are unclickable when you log in. It might be possible to fix this with a patch but I'm not sure if it's feasible at all. The current workaround is to add the videos into a playlist and watch them there.
- Opening the video settings menu crashes the app. This is a app-related issue caused by the (now mandatory) version spoof patch.
